<div class="card-body">
'''Solomahal''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ソロマハール</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：任意の戦士に配備して偵察兵の能力を与える。その戦士は"リアクション"として隣接する位置カードに移動できる。2：任意の偵察兵に配備する。その偵察兵は"リアクション"を行う場合、戦闘力＋2となる。このエフェクトは「意識操作」の影響を受けない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Solomahal-SWCA-67716.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">旧共和国の古参士官であったが、クローン大戦の後で前線を退いた。アウターリムで偵察技術を教えて生計をたてている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Solomahal.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one. Deploy on any warrior to give scout skill; that warrior may move to an adjacent location card as a react. Or deploy on any scout; that scout is power +2 when reacting. This Effect is not affected by Alter.

'''Lore:'''
A veteran officer of the Old Republic who left the front after the Clone Wars. He makes a living in the Outer Rim teaching scouting skills.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Functions are numbered 1/2 under どちらかを選ぶ instead of OR.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Solomahal]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
